goal: Prevent debug assertion failures when an orphan enters the mempool through RPC or non-peer mechanisms.
Ensure 1P1C package relay skips and removes orphans that are already admitted to the mempool.
agreement: Verified by reproducing the assertion failure on master and testing the fix (fametrano)
Prefers reactive cleanup during package selection over adding mempool hooks (fametrano)
Suggested proactive cleanup on mempool entry, answered and declined for now (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an assertion failure triggered in debug builds during an uncommon orphan race.
Edge case requires an orphan transaction to enter the mempool via RPC or other non-peer relay.
